original: tatra hi bhā,ye'rthānāṃ jñānaviṣayatvamātramabhihitaṃ, na tāvatā bhavadabhimatasddhaḥ, nāpi kāciddhāniḥ pareṣām | tatra vāgīndriyasya yugapadvarṇadvayoccāraṇasāmarthyābhāvāt, pūrvarṇanāśettarameva uttaravarṇotpattesca naṣṭavartamānayoḥ paurvāparyasaṃbhavena saṃnikarṣābhāvātsūtramanupapannamiti `na hi varṇānāṃ paurvāparyamasti' ityādinā
analyzed: tatra hi jñāna viṣaya tva mātram abhihitam na tāvatā bhavat abhimata sddhaḥ nā api kācid hāniḥ pareṣām tatra vāc indriyasya yugapad varṇa dvaya uccāraṇa sāmarthya abhāvāt pūrva ṛṇa nāśa ittaram eva uttara varṇa utpatteḥ ca naṣṭa vartamānayoḥ paurvāparya saṃbhavena saṃnikarṣa abhāvāt sūtram anupapannam iti na hi varṇānām paurvāparyam asti ityādinā

original: varṇā'nityatvavādinā pūrvapakṣite, śabdānāṃ nityatvapakṣe na doṣa iti samādhatte buddhāvityādinā | ślokārthamāha bhāṣyakṛt ---`buddhiviṣayameva śabdānāṃ paurvāparyam' iti | idamādyapādārthavivaraṇam | kṛtvāśāstraṃ pravartitamiti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: varṇa anitya tva vādinā pūrvapakṣite śabdānām nitya tva pakṣe na doṣaḥ iti samādhatte buddhau ityādinā śloka artham āha bhāṣyakṛt buddhi viṣayam eva śabdānām paurvāparyam iti idam ādya pāda artha vivaraṇam kṛtvā śāstram pravartitam iti śeṣaḥ

original: ke te śabdā ityata āha-iha ca ya eva manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati sa paśyati asminnarte'yaṃ śabdaḥ prayoktavya iti | idaṃ bhāṣyaṃ dvitīyatṛtūyapādārthavivaraṇaparam | dhīraḥ tanvannītirityanayorartaḥ -- prekṣāpūrvakārīti | samastaviṣayavyāpanaśīlabuddhimānpaṇḍita iti tadarthaḥ | bhavatītyasya ślokasthakartetyanenānvayaḥ |
analyzed: ke te śabdāḥ iti atas āha eha ca yaḥ eva manuṣyaḥ prekṣā pūrva kārī bhavati sa paśyati asmin artā iyam śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti idam bhāṣyam dvitīya tṛtūya pāda artha vivaraṇa param dhīraḥ tanvan nītiḥ iti anayoḥ artaḥ prekṣā pūrva kārī iti samasta viṣaya vyāpana śīla buddhimān paṇḍitaḥ iti tad arthaḥ bhavati iti asya śloka stha kartā iti anena anvayaḥ

original: kartā -- prayoktā bhavatītyartaṃḥ | `sa paśyati' iti tṛtīyapādārthavivaraṇam | akṣarārthaḥ spa,ṭaḥ | anena vācyān -- upadeṣṭavyān arthān, śabdena-etaiḥ śabdaiḥ bodhayāmi iti, dṛṣṭvā-niścitya, yadvā śabdena vācyānartān etacchabdavācyo'yamartha iti niścityetyakṣarārthaḥ sūcitaḥ | etena, śabdena sahitānarthāniti vyāśyānamapāstam |
analyzed: kartā prayoktā bhavati iti artaṃḥ sa paśyati iti tṛtīya pāda artha vivaraṇam akṣara arthaḥ spaṭaḥ anena vācyān upadeṣṭavyān arthān śabdena etaiḥ śabdaiḥ bodhayāmi iti dṛṣṭvā a niścitya yat vā śabdena vācyān artān etad śabda vācyaḥ ayam arthaḥ iti niścitya iti akṣara arthaḥ sūcitaḥ etena śabdena sahitān arthān iti vyāśyānam apāstam

original: `asminnarte'yaṃ śabdaḥ prayoktavya iti pasyati' iti tu tātparyakathanam | `artaṃ budhvā śabdaracanā' iti nyāyāt ayaṃ śabdo bodhanīyārthavācakaḥ, ayaṃ śabdo'trārte prayoktavya iti dhīro niścinotīti bhāvaḥ | uktaṃ paurvāparyasya buddhiviṣayatvamupapādayati -- asmīn tākat śabde'ye tāvadvarṇastato'yaṃ tato'yamitīti | asti krama iti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: asmin artā iyam śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ iti pasyati iti tu tātparya kathanam artam budhvā śabda racanā iti nyāyāt ayam śabdaḥ bodhanīya artha vācakaḥ ayam prayoktavyaḥ iti dhīraḥ niścinoti iti bhāvaḥ uktam paurvāparyasya buddhi viṣaya tvam upapādayati tākat śabdeye tāvat varṇaḥ tatoyam tatoyam iti iti asti kramaḥ iti śeṣaḥ

original: asya `iti paurvāparyaṃ buddau kuryāt' iti ślokasthena saṃbandhaḥ | karteti kartṛpadamadyāhāryam | saṃbhāvanāyāṃ liṅ | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ --- śabdāstavannityāḥ kramaviśiṣṭāśca prayoktavyatvena buddhiviṣayā iti tadgatakramo'pi nāntarīyakatayā vaktṛbuddiviṣayo bhavatyeva |
analyzed: asya iti paurvāparyam buddau kuryāt iti śloka sthena saṃbandhaḥ kartā iti kartṛ padam adya āhāryam saṃbhāvanāyām ayam bhāvaḥ śabdāḥ tavat nityāḥ krama viśiṣṭāḥ ca prayoktavya tvena buddhi viṣayāḥ iti tad gata kramaḥ api nāntarīyaka tayā vaktṛ buddi viṣayaḥ bhavati eva

original: tataśca paurvāparyamapi tadbuddiviṣaya iti tadeva paurvāparyaṃ sāstrapravṛttiprayojakamiti niścatya pravartitamācāryaiḥ śāstramiti |
analyzed: tatas ca paurvāparyam api tad buddi viṣayaḥ iti tat eva paurvāparyam sāstra pravṛtti prayojakam iti niścatya pravartitam ācāryaiḥ śāstram iti

original: nanu sphoṭa eva nityaḥ śabdaḥ tatra tu varṇakramau na tasyā'khaṇḍatvādityuktam, tatkathamevamucyata iti cet, na | rekhāgavayanyāyena śāstramanuśāsakaṃ śabdānāmiti siddāntena rekhāsthānīye vyañjake kramasadbhāvena ghaṭaśabdena paṭopasthītivāpaṇāya vyaṅgye sphoṭe vyañjakagadharmāropa āvaśyaka iti bhavataivoktatvāt tatrāpi varṇakramasadbhāvena
analyzed: nanu sphoṭaḥ eva nityaḥ śabdaḥ tatra tu varṇa kramau na tasya akhaṇḍa tvāt iti uktam tat katham evam ucyate iti ced na rekhāgavaya nyāyena śāstram anuśāsakam śabdānām iti siddāntena rekhā sthānīye vyañjake krama sadbhāvena ghaṭa śabdena paṭa upasthīti vāpaṇāya vyaṅgye sphoṭe vyañjaka ga dharma āropaḥ āvaśyakaḥ iti bhavatā eva ukta tvāt tatra api varṇa krama sadbhāvena

original: vyaṅgye vyañjake ca varṇakramayoḥ sattvāt | anena buddhiviṣayatvamevārtānāmuktaṃ na tu tadatiriktabauddhasatteti nirmatsarā nipuṇadhiṣaṇāḥ pratipadyeranniti |
analyzed: vyaṅgye vyañjake ca varṇa kramayoḥ sattvāt anena buddhi viṣaya tvam eva ārtānām uktam na tu tad atirikta bauddha sattā iti nirmatsarāḥ nipuṇa dhiṣaṇāḥ pratipadyeran iti

original: stānivatsūtre ca bhāṣyakāraḥ padārthānāṃ bauddhatvaṃ kaṇṭhato nooo brūte | tatra hi--- `pracīnaṃ grāmādāmrā' iti upadeśe grāmaprācīdeśe vidyamānavṛkṣasāmānye prasajantī āmratvabuddiḥ, tatratyeṣu nyāgrodheṣvapi prasattā | sā `ye kṣīriṇo'varohavantaḥ pṛthuparṇāste nyagrodā' iti viseṣopadesena nivartate |
analyzed: stānivat sūtre ca bhāṣyakāraḥ padārthānām bauddha tvam kaṇṭhataḥ brūte tatra hi pracīnam grāmāt āmrāḥ iti upadeśe grāma prācī deśe vidyamāna vṛkṣa sāmānye prasajantī āmra tva buddiḥ tatratyeṣu nyāgrodheṣu api prasattā sā ye kṣīriṇaḥ uvarohavantaḥ pṛthu parṇāḥ te nyagrodāḥ iti viseṣa upadesena nivartate

original: tata upadiṣṭaḥ puru,ḥ nyagrodhe āmratvabaraddhiṃ na karotīti uktam | etadbhāṣyeṇāpi padārtho buddhiviṣayo bhavatītyeva sidhyati na tu buddhistha iti | bhāṣye apakṛṣyamāṇānityasya nivartyamānānityarthaḥ, na tu cittasthānapakṛṣyeti | buddhigatanivṛttyutpattyorvastuni āropa ityuktamuddyote, na tu buddhistavastugate apakarṣopadhāne iti |
analyzed: tatas upadiṣṭaḥ puruḥ nyagrodhe āmra tva baraddhim na karoti iti uktam etad bhāṣyeṇa api padārthaḥ buddhi viṣayaḥ bhavati iti eva sidhyati na tu buddhi sthaḥ iti bhāṣye apakṛṣyamāṇa anityasya nivartyamāna anitya arthaḥ na tu cittasthān apakṛṣya iti buddhi gata nivṛtti utpattyoḥ vastuni āropaḥ iti uktam uddyote na tu buddhista vastu gate apakarṣa upadhāne iti

original: athocyeta -- bauddārtā'naṅgīkāre `sa bhūriti vyāharat sa būmimasṛjata' (tai.btā.2.2.4.2)
analyzed: athā ucyeta baudda ārta an aṅgīkāre sa bhūḥ iti vyāharat sa būmim asṛjata taibtā2242

original: sarveṣāṃ tu sanāmāni karmāṇi ca pṛthakpṛthak |
analyzed: sarveṣām tu sa nāmāni karmāṇi ca pṛthak pṛthak

original: vedaśabdebhya evādau pṛthaksaṃsthāśca virmame || (manu.9.21)
analyzed: veda śabdebhyaḥ eva ādau pṛthak saṃsthāḥ ca virmame manu

original: iti śrutismṛtibhyāṃ bhūḥśabdādibhyastadarthajñānapūrvamuktā bhūmyādisṛṣṭirnopapadyeta, sṛṣṭoḥ pūrvaṃ bājhāyā bhuvo'bhāvena bhūḥśabdādibhyaḥ sisṛkṣitabhūmyādipadārthaśaktigrahabodhayoranudayāt |
analyzed: iti śruti smṛtibhyām bhūḥ śabda ādibhyaḥ tad artha jñāna pūrvam uktā bhūmi ādi sṛṣṭiḥ na upapadyeta sṛṣṭoḥ pūrvam bājhāyāḥ bhuvarbhāvena bhūḥ śabda ādibhyaḥ sisṛkṣita bhūmi ādi padārtha śakti graha bodhayoḥ anudayāt

original: bauddhārthāṅgīkāre tu hiraṇyagarbhasya svabuddhisthabhūmyādipadrthe śaktigrahastadviṣayakabodhaśca bhavatīti sṛjyamānapadārthajñānasadbhāvena śrutyādyuktasṛṣṭirupapadyata iti śakyate vaktumiti satyam | pūrvakalpasthitān bhūmyādīn bhūḥśabdādibhyo vijñāya asṛjaditi śrutismṛtitātparyeṇa sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaṃ bājhārthābhāve'pi na sṛṣṭikathanānupapattiḥ |
analyzed: bauddha artha aṅgīkāre tu hiraṇyagarbhasya sva buddhi stha bhūmi ādi pad rthe śakti grahaḥ tad viṣayaka bodhaḥ ca bhavati iti sṛjyamāna padārtha jñāna sadbhāvena śruti ādi ukta sṛṣṭiḥ upapadyate iti śakyate vaktum iti satyam pūrva kalpa sthitān bhūmi ādīn bhūḥ śabda ādibhyaḥ vijñāya asṛjat iti śruti smṛti tātparyeṇa sṛṣṭeḥ pūrvam na sṛṣṭi kathana anupapattiḥ

original: `satyapi sarvavyavahārocchedini mahāpralaye parameśvarānugrahāt hiraṇyagarbhādīnāṃ kalpāntaravyavahārānusaṃdānopapatteḥ' iti `samānanāma-' iti sūtre śrīśaṅkarācāryādibhiruktatvena, `yasya pūrvakalpe yānyāsan ādau sṛṣṭyādau vedāśabdebhya evāvagamya nirmama' iti manuvacanavyākhyānena ca kalpāntarasthitapadārthaśaktigrahabodhābhyāṃ
analyzed: sati api sarva vyavahāra ucchedini mahāpralaye parameśvara anugrahāt hiraṇyagarbha ādīnām kalpa antara vyavahāra anusaṃdāna upapatteḥ iti samāna nāmaḥ iti sūtre śrī śaṅkara ācārya ādibhiḥ ukta tvena yasya pūrva kalpe yāni āsan ādau sṛṣṭi ādau eva avagamya nirmamaḥ iti manu vacana vyākhyānena ca kalpa antara sthita padārtha śakti graha bodhābhyām

original: śrutyādyuktasṛṣṭīrupapanneti nedamarthasya bauddhatve pramāṇaṃ bhavitumarhati | patañjaliridaṃ śrutyādi nāgeśoktadiśā kvāpi bhāṣye na vyācaṣṭe | `śabda iti cenna' (bra.sū.1.3.17) `samānanāma-' iti sūtradvayaśaṅkarabhā,yaṃ, manusmṛtivyākhyānaṃ cānavalokya, tatroktārtho'saṃgata iti matvā vā evamabhihitavānnāgeśa iti bhāti |
analyzed: śruti ādi ukta sṛṣṭīḥ upapannā iti na idam arthasya bauddha tve pramāṇam bhavitum arhati patañjaliḥ idam śruti ādi nāgeśa ukta diśā kvāpi bhāṣye na vyācaṣṭe śabdaḥ iti ced na brasū samāna nāmaḥ iti sūtra dvaya śaṅkara bhāyam manusmṛti vyākhyānam ca an avalokya tatra ukta arthaḥ usaṃgataḥ iti matvā vā evam abhihitavān nāgeśaḥ iti bhāti

original: paṇḍitā eva mañjūṣāyāṃ pradarśitaprakārāntareṣu pratividhātumīśata iti na tatra pravarte vistarabhiyā |
analyzed: paṇḍitāḥ eva mañjūṣāyām pradarśita prakāra antareṣu pratividhātum īśate iti na tatra pravarte vistara bhiyā

original: kecitu -- śaśaviṣāṇaāditucchavastuviṣayakavikalpākhyavṛttiḥ svaviṣayavastuno na padavṛttiviṣayatāmapekṣate, deśakālasaṃbandhavata eva padavṛttiviṣayatvaṃ, tacchasya tu tadabhāvanna tattvam, spaṣṭaṃ cedamadvaitasiddhitadvyākhyānayoravidyānirvācyatvanirūpaṇaprakaraṇe | tatra hi -- nirupākhyatvamasattvam, nirūpākyatvasya padavṛttyaviṣayatvarūpatvāt |
analyzed: kecid tu śaśaviṣāṇa ādi tuccha vastu viṣayaka vikalpa ākhya vṛttiḥ sva viṣaya vastunaḥ na pada vṛtti viṣayatām apekṣate deśa kāla saṃbandhavataḥ eva pada vṛtti viṣaya tvam tu tad abhāvat na tattvam spaṣṭam ca idam advaita siddhi tad vyākhyānayoḥ avidyā nirvācya tva nirūpaṇa prakaraṇe tatra hi nirupākhya tvam asattvam nirūpākya tvasya pada vṛtti aviṣaya tva rūpa tvāt

original: deśakālasaṃbandhābhāvena tucchasya na padavṛttiviṣayatvaṃ, śaśaviṣaṇādipadajanyo vikalpastu na padavṛttisāpekṣaḥ, śabdapramāviparyayoreva tattvāditibhāvaḥ' (vyā.candrikā) ityuktam | śaśaviṣāṇādiśabdaiḥ śaktigrahādyapekṣāmantareṇāpi bodho jāyate śabdaśaktimahimneti `śabdajñāna' iti sūtratātparyamiti tayorāśayaḥ |
analyzed: deśa kāla saṃbandha abhāvena tucchasya na pada vṛtti viṣaya tvam śaśa viṣaṇa ādi pada janyaḥ vikalpaḥ tu na pada vṛtti sāpekṣaḥ śabda pramā viparyayoḥ eva tattvāt iti bhāvaḥ vyācandrikāḥ iti uktam śaśa viṣāṇa ādi śabdaiḥ śakti graha ādi apekṣām antareṇa api bodhaḥ jāyate śabda śakti mahimnā iti śabda jñāne iti sūtra tātparyam iti tayoḥ āśayaḥ

original: evaṃ ca ṇasatāṃ bauddhasattāmantarāpi nirvāhāt teṣāṃ tatkalpanaṃ mudhaiva | udāhṛtamahā bhāṣyārthā'paryālocanayā advaitasiddhyādau tatoktiriti tu na saheran vipaścitaḥ | na ca, buddhyatiriktadeśasaṃbandhābhāva iti tattātparyamiti vācyam, saṃkoce kāraṇābhāvāt, evaṃ kalpanāpekṣayā tatpathāśrayaṇasya varatvāt |
analyzed: evam ca bauddha sattām antarā api nirvāhāt teṣām tat kalpanam mudhā eva udāhṛta mahā bhāṣya artha a paryālocanayā advaita siddhi ādau tata uktiḥ iti tu na saheran vipaścitaḥ na ca buddhi atirikta deśa saṃbandha abhāvaḥ iti tat tātparyam iti vācyam saṃkoce kāraṇa abhāvāt evam kalpanā apekṣayā tad patha āśrayaṇasya vara tvāt

original: na ca atra vṛttijñānamantarā śābdabodha ityaṅgīkāre tatpadajanyaśābdabuddhiṃ prati tatpadanirūpitavṛttijñānaṃ heturiti vyāptepādikatvānāpattiriti vācyam | anuraṇādibodhātiriktabodhaviṣayakatvakalpanenādauṣa ityāśayāt | na caivamapi vṛttyabhāve prātipādikatvānāpattiriti vācyam |
analyzed: na ca atra vṛtti jñānam antarā śābda bodhaḥ iti aṅgīkāre tad pada janya śābda buddhim prati tad pada nirūpita vṛtti jñānam hetuḥ iti vyāpti īpādikatva anāpattiḥ iti vācyam iti āśayāt na ca evam api vṛtti abhāve prātipādikatva anāpattiḥ iti vācyam

original: anukaraṇasthale sādṛśyākhyasaṃbandhena anukāryabodhakatvena arthavattvātprātipadikatvavat śabdajñānottarabhāvivikalpākhyavṛttiviṣayatāsaṃbandhena asadarthabodhakatvāt arthavattvena prātipadikatvopapatteḥ |
analyzed: anukaraṇa sthale sādṛśya ākhya saṃbandhena anukārya bodhaka tvena arthavat tvāt prātipadika tva vat śabda jñāna uttara bhāvi vikalpa ākhya vṛtti viṣayatā saṃbandhena asat artha bodhaka tvāt arthavat tvena prātipadika tva upapatteḥ

original: kiṃ ca, matupsūtrakaiyaṭoktamevārtham `evaṃ śakyo'pyartha' ityā dinā nirūpya, `sattāpi śabdavācyeti tadbhāva' ityuktatvena sarvamidaṃ kaiyaṭābimatameva na tu svābhimatamityapi vaktaṃ śakyam |
analyzed: kim ca matup sūtra kaiyaṭa uktam eva artham evam śakyaḥ api arthaḥ ityā dinā nirūpya sattā api śabda vācyā iti tad bhāvaḥ iti uktatvena sarvam idam kaiyaṭa abimatam eva na tu sva abhimatam iti api vaktam śakyam

original: na ca `buddhistapadārthāṅgīkartraśaya' iti kalāyāṃ vyākhyānāt nāgeśasyāpi iṣṭametaditi jānīma iti kalāyāṃ vyākhyānāt nāgeśasyāpi iṣṭametaditi jānīma iti vācyam, tadvyākyānasya `tadbhāva' iti akṣarānuguṇatvāt | yadi idaṃ svasyeṣaṭaṃ syāt tarhi `sattāpi śabdavācyā' ityetāvadevāvakṣyat |
analyzed: na ca buddhiḥ ta padārtha aṅgīkartṛ aśayaḥ iti kalāyām vyākhyānāt nāga īśasya api iṣṭam etat iti jānīmaḥ iti kalāyām vyākhyānāt nāga īśasya api iṣṭam etat iti jānīmaḥ iti vācyam tad vyākyānasya tad bhāvaḥ iti akṣara anuguṇa tvāt yadi idam svasya iṣaṭam syāt tarhi sattā api śabda vācyā iti etāvat eva avakṣyat

original: sarvo'pi padārtānāṃ bauddhatvanirūpaṇaparo mañjūṣāgranthaḥ kaiyaṭoktasyaivopodbalakaḥ | astu vā kaloktadisā nāgeśasyāpi saṃmatametaditi, tāvatāpi na kiṃciddiyate pramāṇapramitaprapañcasatyatāvādinām |

original: tathā hi -- tatrādye `hantyātmānam' ityaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ karmabhūtasyātmanaḥ, `ghātayatyātmā' iti ṇyantāvastāyāṃ kartṛtvāt | anenātmanepadaṃ syāditi codye `ātmanaḥ karmatve pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ' iti vacanaṃ pravṛttam | aṇau karmaṇa ātmano ṇaukartṛtve'pi nānenātmanepadamiti tadarthaḥ |

original: nedaṃ niṣedhavacanaṃ kartavyaṃ prathamakakṣyāyāṃ karmaṇo dvitīyakakṣyāyāṃ kartṛtvābhāvādityabhipretyāha--`na vā ṇyantasya kartṛtvāt' iti | tadarthamāha -- anyadatrā'ṇyante karma anyo ṇyantasya kartā, katham ? `dvāvātmānau' ityādi | bhāṣyārthaḥ spaṣṭaḥ | ayaṃbhāvaḥ--antarātmā īśvaro'ntaryāmi, śarīrātmā jīvaḥ |

original: patañjasimate īśvaraḥ puraṣa iti cetanadvayamastīti yogasūtrato lābhāt | idamantarātmanaḥ karma yat purūṣasya (jāvasya) tattatpuṇyapāpānusāreṇa tattaducitavyāpāre pravartanam | tena svakarmānusārātpuruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhe anubhavati, yadā puṇya karma karoti jīvaḥ, tadā antarātmā tadanuguṇaphalapradānāyajāgarti | tadeva tasya sukham |

original: etena aṅgasauṣṭhavaṃ tadvaikalyaṃ ca śarīrātmanaḥ sukhaduḥkhānubhava iti pratyakṣasiddhatvāt, tayoranubhavasya cetanadharmatvena śarīrasya tadayogācca | `hanti ātmānam' ityasya purūṣaḥ anyāyācaraṇena ātmānaṃ nāśayati ityartaḥ ghātayatyātmetyasya antarātmā īśvaraḥ ātmānaṃ puruṣaṃ ghātayati, tadīyaduṣkarmamā ado nayatītyarthaḥ |

original: tatra vararucinā yadacetaneṣbityuktaṃ tat jñāpayati `īśvaracetanena sarvasya cetanāvattvavyavahāra' iti | etena śāstre'pi tena sarvasya tathā vyavahāro netyevetyadhyavasātavyam | evaṃ ca, īśvarātiriktacetanasattva eva cetanāvattvavyavahāraḥ kūlādiṣu ca īsvarānyacetanābhāvāt icchāyā abhāvena sano'prāptau savarthaṃ taduktiḥ sārthikā |
analyzed: tatra vararucinā yat acetaneṣu iti uktam tat jñāpayati īśvara cetanena sarvasya cetanāvat tva vyavahāraḥ iti etena śāstre api tena sarvasya tathā vyavahāraḥ na iti eva iti adhyavasātavyam evam ca īśvara atirikta cetana sattve eva cetanāvat tva vyavahāraḥ kūla ādiṣu ca īsvara anya cetanā bhāvāt icchāyāḥ abhāvena tad uktiḥ sārthikā

original: evaṃ ca cetanaikyaṃ na tatsaṃmatam | bhāṣkārasya tu īśvarādanyā asti kācidamimānidevatā nāma cetanā | tāmādāya kūlādau cetanāvattvamiti icchāyāṃ sūtreṇaiva sanniti tātparyam |

original: idaṃ tu bodhyam--bhāṣyamidaṃ brajhavidāṃ matamāsthāya pravṛttam, vārtikaṃ tu brajhavitsiddhāntasya sarvairaparijñānāt tadanāśritya | idaṃ ta teṣāṃ matam `āpo'bravan, mṛdabravīt, āpa aikṣanta' ityādiśratirapramāṇam acetanānāmavādīnāṃ vacanādikartṛtvāyogāt | loke'cetanaghaṭapaṭādīnāṃ vacanādyanupalambhāditi śahkāyām, naivaṃ mantavyam |
analyzed: idam tu bodhyam bhāṣyam idam brajha vidām matam āsthāya pravṛttam vārtikam tu brajha vid siddhāntasya sarvaiḥ aparijñānāt tat an āśritya idam te teṣām matam mṛd abravīt āpaḥ aikṣanta ityādi śratiḥ apramāṇam acetanānām avādīnām vacana ādi kartṛ tva ayogāt loke cetana ghaṭa paṭa ādīnām vacana ādi anupalambhāt iti śahkāyām na evam mantavyam

original: asti tāvatsarvatra kācanā'bhimānidevatā | tāmādāya vedapuruṣa evaṃ vyavaharati | śrutau āpa ityādīnāṃ tadabhimānidevatā ityarthaḥ | siddhāntitaṃ caivameva bhagavatā vyosena `abhimānivyapadeśastu viśeṣānugatibhyām' (bra.sū.2.1.5) iti sūtreṇa |

original: `mṛdabravīdityādau mṛdādyabhimānidevatānāṃ vacanādikartṛvyavahāraḥ, sarvatrābhimānidevatāsadbhāvasya ca mantrārthavādetihāsādibhiḥ siddhatvāditi sūtrārthaḥ | īśvaracetanena sarvasya cetanatāyāṃ nedamupapadyeta | evaṃ ca īśvarādanyā amimānidevatānāma kācanāstīti īśvaraikacetanavādo brajhavitsiddhāntaviruddhaḥ |

original: `na hi brajhātiriktamajaṃ saṃbhavati'iti bhāṣyasya tu tadatiriktaṃ svatantramajaṃ nāsitītyarthenā'doṣa iti tatsaṃpradāyavidaḥ | ata eva śāṅkare gītābhāṣyeye `prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhyanādī ubhāvapi' (gī.13.19) iti ślokavyākhyāvasare īśvarasyeśvaratvamanupapannam' ityuktam |

original: advaitasiddhau ca dṛṣṭisṛṣṭivāde sarveṣāṃ sṛṣṭatve `jīva īśo viśūddhā cit' iti prācāṃ vacanavirodhaḥ | tatra jīvādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāmanā ditvoktayā teṣāmajanyatvādityāśaṅkya anādyatiriktasṛṣṭiviṣaya eva dṛṣṭisṛṣṭisvīkārāditi samāhitam, `jīvabrajhavibhāgasyā'nāditvena' iti tatraiva vāde spaṣṭam, tatraiva avidyāyāḥ cinmātrāśrayatvavicāre nāpi jīvasya
analyzed: advaitasiddhau ca dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi vāde sarveṣām sṛṣṭa tve jīvaḥ īśaḥ cit iti prācām vacana virodhaḥ tatra jīva ādīnām ṣaṇṇām anā ādi tva uktayā teṣām ajanya tvāt iti āśaṅkya anādi atirikta sṛṣṭi viṣayaḥ eva dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi svīkārāt iti samāhitam jīva brajha vibhāgasya anādi tvena iti tatra eva vāde spaṣṭam tatra eva avidyāyāḥ cit mātra āśraya tva vicāre na api jīvasya anādi tvena iti tatra eva vāde spaṣṭam tatra

original: yathā māyāyā īśvare layaḥ saṃbandhaviśeṣa eveti nāgeśo'vadat, lathā harau prakṛtirūpakāraṇasya layasaṃbandhaviśeṣa eva iti anyepi prabhavanti | ataḥ etāni kathamuktārthe pramāṇāni syuriti vibhāvyatām | kiṃ ca anādyavidyāsahakāreṇa īśvaraḥ sṛjatītyaṅkīkāre'pi svatantravastvantarānapekṣatvamātreṇa prapañcasya ekakāraṇakatvasiddhaḥ |

original: etatpraghaṭṭake `uktajātīyaśrutīnāṃ maduktavyākhyaivocitā' iti nāgeśoktyā ca anāditvavādināṃ śrutiyojanā anyādṛśīti bhāti |

original: kiṃ ca vaiṣamyanairghuṇyādhikaraṇa (bra.sū.2.1.12) śāṅkarabhāṣye brajhātiriktasṛṣṭihetvanādivastusattā pratipāditā | kiṃ ca `bhramātsaṃskārato'pyanyā maṇḍūkamadudāhṛteḥ | avidyā'nādibhāvātmā matā vācaspateriha' iti devatādhikaraṇīyakalpataruṇāpi anādibhāvarūpā'vidyā vācaspatisaṃmatetyuktam |
analyzed: kim ca vaiṣamya nairghuṇya adhikaraṇa brasū śāṅkara bhāṣye brajha atirikta sṛṣṭi hetu anādi vastu sattā pratipāditā kim ca bhramāt saṃskāratā upi anyā maṇḍūka mad udāhṛteḥ avidyā anādi bhāva ātmā matā vācaspateḥ iha iti devatā adhikaraṇīya kalpataruṇā api anādi bhāva rūpa avidyā vācaspati saṃmatā iti uktam

original: tatrehetyasya śrīśāṅkarīyāṇāṃ mate ityarthaḥ, devatādhikaraṇa iti saṃkoce kāraṇabhāva iti pūrvaprakaraṇe nirūpitam |

original: nanu parādhīnasattākatvaṃ janyatvamityaṅkīkāre viyadāderapi tathātvābhyupagamena janyatvaṃ suvacamiti viyadāderutpattisādhanaprayāso vyartha iti viyadadhikaraṇānutthitiprasaṃga iti cet, ucyate -- `ātmana ākāśa' ityādāvakāśasyotpattiśravaṇāt tadanutpattivādaḥ śrutiviruddha iti bodhanāya tatsamarthanamānaśyakam, avidyāyā utpatteḥ kvāpyaśravaṇena

original: `anādi māyayā' ityanāditvaśravaṇena brajhaṇaḥ sarvaniyākatvaśravaṇena ca evamaṅkīkṛtamiti | adhikamadvaitagrantheṣu draṣṭavyam |

original: kiṃ ca `asti karmākyamanādivastu śubhā'śubhaṃ prāṇināṃ janmāntarakāraṇam' ityarthaka `na karmā'vibhāgāditi cennā'nāditvāt' (bra.sū.2.1.36) iti vyāsasūtravirūddhaṃ nāgeśavacavam | tena ca sūtreṇā'nādivastu kiṃcidasti' iti pratipādanāt |
analyzed: kim ca asti karma ākyam anādi vastu śubha aśubham prāṇinām janma antara kāraṇam na karma avibhāgāt iti ced na anādi tvāt brasū iti vyāsa sūtra virūddham nāgeśa vacavam tena ca sūtreṇa anādi vastu kiṃcid asti iti pratipādanāt

original: avidyāyā anādibhāvatvakathanaṃ `yāvadavikāraṃ tu vibhāgo lokavat' (bra.sū.2.3.8) iti sūtreṇa kāryatvasya bhedavyāpyatvabodhakena ākāśasyevādiyāyā api atathātva (kāryatva) bodhanāt tadviruddhamiti mañjūṣoktaṃ dūṣaṇamapi na samīcīnam, ākāśādibhūtotpattiviṣaya eva vicārasya tatra `brajhaṇo'dharmakatvena kiṃcinnirūpitabhedo brajhaṇī na iti na tasya
analyzed: avidyāyāḥ anādi bhāva tva kathanam yāvat avikāram tu vibhāgaḥ loka vat brasū iti sūtreṇa kāryatvasya bheda vyāpya tva bodhakena ākāśasya iva ādiyāyāḥ api atathātva kāryatva bodhanāt tat viruddham iti mañjūṣā uktam dūṣaṇam api na samīcīnam ākāśa ādi bhūta utpatti viṣaye eva vicārasya tatra kiṃcid nirūpita bhedaḥ na iti na tasya

original: janyatnam' iti, taccintyam, brajhaṇo'dharmakatvaṃ vadacosya mate pratiyogitvasyāpi dharmasya brajhaṇī asaṃbhavena avidyāyāṃ śuddhabrajhabhedasya sattvāt, kāryatvamāyāti' iti svoktivirodhāt | tataśca brajhaṇo'pi kiṃcinnirūpitabhedavattā suvaceti tacasyāpi kāryatvāpātaḥ |
analyzed: iti tat cintyam brajhaṇaḥ dharmaka tvam mate pratiyogi tvasya api dharmasya brajhaṇī asaṃbhavena avidyāyām śuddha brajha bhedasya sattvāt kāryatvam āyāti iti sva ukti virodhāt tatas ca brajhaṇaḥ api kiṃcid nirūpita bhedavat tā suvacā iti tacasya api kāryatva āpātaḥ

original: kiṃ ca `yāvadvikāraṃ tu' iti sūtrabhāmatīkalpataruparimalādgranthānavalokanena vā, tatra taduktamasaṃgatamiti pratipipādayiṣayā vā, ayamatrā'vidyānāditvaṃ dūṣayatīti bhāti |
analyzed: kim ca yāvadvikāram tu iti sūtra bhāmatī kalpataru parimalāt grantha anavalokanena vā tatra tat uktam asaṃgatam iti pratipipādayiṣayā vā ayam atra avidyā anāditvam dūṣayati iti bhāti

original: tatra hi sūtre bhāmatyā brajhā (ātmā) nyatve sati vibhaktatvāditi heturuktaḥ, kalpatararau ca -- avidyādāvityādinā `ṣaḍasmākamanādaya' ityuktajīveśvarādyarthāntarasaṃgraha ityuktam | etena prabandhatrayeṇa avidyādyānāditvaṃ bhāṣyakṛtsaṃmatamiti pratipadyate |
analyzed: tatra hi sūtre bhāmatyā ātmā nyatve sati vibhakta tvāt iti hetuḥ uktaḥ kalpatararau ca avidyā ādau ityādinā ṣaṭ asmākam anādayaḥ iti ukta jīva īśvara ādi artha antara saṃgrahaḥ iti uktam etena prabandha trayeṇa avidyā ādi anādi tvam bhāṣyakṛt saṃmatam iti pratipadyate

original: miśrādayo hi na kadācidbhāṣyakṛdanabhimatamarthaṃ pratipādayeyuḥ, bhāṣye'pyavidyādīnāmanāditvaṃ tatra tatrā'bhihitam | ato `na sā bhāṣyasaṃmatā' iti nāgeśoktiścintyaiva |
analyzed: miśra ādayaḥ hi na kadācid bhāṣyakṛt anabhimatam artham pratipādayeyuḥ bhāṣye pi avidyā ādīnām anādi tvam tatra tatra abhihitam atas na sā bhāṣya saṃmatā iti nāgeśa uktiḥ cintyā eva

original: etena `saṃbhṛṣṭādhyāsa' iti ānandagirūyādhyāsabhāṣyavyāśyānam, `mūlakāraṇāvidyārūpabhāvapadīrthanimittaka ityarthadha' iti `mithyā jñānanumitta' ityanyeṣāmadhyāsabhāṣyavyākyānaṃ cānūdya `tanna' ityādinā taddūṣaṇamapi cinnyam | avidyānāditvasya bhāṣyasaṃmatatvokteḥ |

original: ayaṃ tāvanmahadbhirācāryairvirṛtārthāni sūtrāgyakṣarāṇi anyathā yojayatīti suvyaktaṃ mañjūṣādṛśām | atredamudāharaṇam--`pratijñāhāniravyatirekācchabdebhyaḥ' (bra.sū.2.3.7) iti sūtre akārapraśleṣamakṛtvā pratijñābhahkaḥ syāt iti vyākhyā pratijñāhānyāpādanaparatayā sūtrakhaṇḍaṃ yojayitvā ahāniriti akārapraśleṣeṇa pratijñāyā ahāniranuparodha iti
analyzed: ayam tāvat mahadbhiḥ ācāryaiḥ virṛta arthāni sūtrāgi akṣarāṇi anyathā yojayati iti su vyaktam mañjūṣā dṛśām atra idam udāharaṇam pratijñāhāniḥ avyatirekāt śabdebhyaḥ brasū iti sūtre akāra praśleṣam a kṛtvā syāt iti vyākhyā pratijñāhāni āpādana para tayā sūtrakhaṇḍam yojayitvā ahāniḥ iti akāra praśleṣeṇa pratijñāyāḥ ahāniḥ an uparodhaḥ iti

original: śrīśaṅkarācāryakṛtasūtravyākhyānādalmadīyacaṃ vyāśyānaṃ varamiti sūcayati nāgeśaḥ | yadyapi akārapraśaleṣatadabhāvayoḥ phalāviśeṣaḥ, athāpi sautrākṣarāṇi yojayituṃ vayameva samartā iti vaiduṣyābhimānapradarśanameva prayojanamiti veditavyam | evamanena bahūnāṃ sūtrāṇāṃ svasamīhitārthaparatayā vilakṣaṇā yojanākṛtā |
analyzed: śrī śaṅkara ācārya kṛta sūtra vyākhyānāt almadīyacam vyāśyānam varam iti sūcayati nāgeśaḥ yadi api akāra praśaleṣa tad abhāvayoḥ phala aviśeṣaḥ atha api sautra akṣarāṇi yojayitum vayam eva samartāḥ iti vaiduṣya abhimāna pradarśanam eva prayojanam iti veditavyam evam anena bahūnām sūtrāṇām sva samīhita artha para tayā vilakṣaṇā yojanā kṛtā

original: sā ca etatkṛtavyāsasūtrendunāmakagranthato'vaseyā | idaṃ jñeyamavidyāpadārthasvarūpanirṇayaviṣaye advaitcāryāṇāṃ pramāda eveti bodhanāyaiva brajhādvaitanirūpaṇamupakrāntaṃ mañjūṣāyāmiti akṣarārthamārmikā iti |

original: avidyābhramasaṃskārarūpā śaṅkarasaṃmatā |

original: taccā'dvaitamatācāryabahagranthavirodhataḥ |

original: na yuktamiti manyante śrīśaṅkaramatānugāḥ ||

original: anirvacanīyatvavādavicāraḥ

original: śabdaḥ - akārādivarṇaḥ, sphoṭaḥ - vyaṃgyaḥ, varṇānāṃ nityatvena tasya tattvam | dhvaniḥ-vaikṛtadhvaniḥ, vaikṛtatvaṃ ca-ālasyādiprayojyatvam, sa cavilaṃbitādivṛttiḥ, śabdaguṇaḥ-varṇasya svarūuābhivyaktyanantaraṃ vyajyamānatattadvarṇaniṣṭho dharmaḥ varṇasyopakārakaḥ, tasya tattvaṃ ca--tattadvṛtti visiṣṭatayā varṇopalabdhimātrahetutvam |
analyzed: śabdaḥ akāra ādi varṇaḥ sphoṭaḥ vyaṃgyaḥ varṇānām nitya tvena tasya tattvam dhvaniḥ vaikṛta dhvaniḥ vaikṛta tvam ca ālasya ādi prayojya tvam sa ca vilaṃbita ādi vṛttiḥ śabda guṇaḥ varṇasya sva rūpa abhivyakti anantaram vyajyamāna tad tad varṇa niṣṭhaḥ dharmaḥ varṇasya upakārakaḥ tasya tattvam ca tat tad vṛtti visiṣṭatayā varṇa upalabdhi mātra hetutvam

original: ataḥ sa dharmo dīrghādivyāvartakahrasvatvādivat vṛttyantaraviśiṣiṭavarṇavyāvartako na bhavati | dṛṣṭāntaṃ vaktuṃ pṛcchati bhāṣye kathamiti | bheeryādyāghātavaditi | atrādhātaśabdo bhāvaghañntaḥ | bheryāāghāta iti ṣaṣṭhīsamāsaḥ | tatastṛtīyāntādvitiḥ | sphoṭa iti śeṣaḥ | sphoṭaḥ bherītāḍanajanyaśabdatulyo bhavatītyartaḥ |

original: bhāṣye dṛṣṭāntavākyatātparyamāha---tadyathā iti | bheryāgāta iti | atra bherīmāhantīti karmaṇyaṇ . upapadasamāsaḥ | āhatyeti | śabdaṃ śṛṇvanniti śeṣaḥ | akṣarārthaḥ spaṣṭaḥ | bhāṣye sphoṭa iti | asya dṛṣṭāntaśeṣatve `athāpi' ityādiḥ | vījātīyagamanaśīlapuruṣeṇa śruto'pītyarthaḥ |

original: sphoṭastāvānevasa - bherīdaṇḍasaṃyogarūpatāḍanakāliparimāṇaviśiṣṭa eva, bhavati-śruyamāṇa ityādiḥ | kathaṃ sabdasya tāvaddaraṃ tathāvdhatvamityata āha bhāṣye-dhvanikṛtātviti | puruṣaniṣṭhavyāpāraviśeṣakṛtaḍhṛḍhataradatamasaṃyoganyadhvanipadābhidheyaśabdīyavijatīyadharmaprayojyetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sphoṭaḥ tāvān eva sa bherī daṇḍa saṃyoga rūpa tāḍana kāli parimāṇa viśiṣṭaḥ eva ityādiḥ katham sabdasya tāvat daram tathā avdha tvam iti atas āha bhāṣye dhvani kṛtā tu iti

original: dṛṣṭāntaśeṣatve yojanākleśamasahamānaḥ kaiyaṭaḥ sphoṭastāvāneveti dārṣṭāntikopanyāsa ityāha atra kalpe evamityādiḥ | evaṃ bherīśabdavat, sphoṭo'pi-akārādirapi, tāvāneva utpaktikālika (abhivyaktikālika) hrasvatvādiviśiṣṭa eva, bhavativartate | na tatra bheda iti bhāvaḥ | bhāṣye vṛttistu na bhedāriṇītyāhadhvanūti | vṛddhiriti | hatvamityarthaḥ |

original: idamupalakṣaṇamalpatvasyāpi iti | mahattvādi tu cirākṛcirakṛtoccāraṇanyānuṣpādidhvanikṛtamiti tātparyam | nāgeśastu `asti bherīśabde'pi sphoṭo'ta idaṃ vākyaṃ dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikobhayaparam' iti maṃjūṣodyotayorāha | tatpakṣe yathātathetyadhyāhṛtya bhāṣyavākyamāvṛtya yojanīyam |

original: śabdārthatattvavidagresaro bhāṣyakāraḥ svānubhūtisiddhamartaṃ (varṇanityatvaṃ) antevāsijakayā bhāṣyakāra) -dhvaniriti |

original: asyārthaḥ -- dhvaniḥ - vyañjakaḥ śabdaḥ, sphoṭaḥ - vyaṃgyaḥ śabdaḥ, alpo mahāśca-dhvaniviśeṣaḥ, idaṃ dvayam-cirāciropalabdhijanakatve alpatvamahatve | tādṛśaḥ - śabdānāṃ saṃbandhī, dhvani| - vaikṛtadhvaniḥ, lakṣyate-jñāyate | dhvaneḥ śabdasaṃbandhitvaṃ tadupalabdhijanakatvena uktadvividhaśabdasattve pramāṇamāha -- ubhayamiti |
analyzed: asya arthaḥ dhvaniḥ vyañjakaḥ śabdaḥ sphoṭaḥ vyaṃgyaḥ śabdaḥ alpaḥ mahāḥ ca dhvani viśeṣaḥ idam dvayam cira acira upalabdhi janaka tve alpatva mahatve tādṛśaḥ śabdānām saṃbandhī dhvani vaikṛta dhvaniḥ lakṣyate jñāyate dhvaneḥ śabda saṃbandhi tvam tad upalabdhi janaka tvena ukta dvividha śabda sattve pramāṇam āha ubhayam iti

original: vyaṅgyatvaṃ vyañjakatvaṃ cetyubha.yam | svabhāvataḥ - svarūpeṇetyarthaḥ | śabdasya tādṛśasvabhāvatvāt na tatra pramāṇāntarāpekṣā | athāpi yogipratyakṣagocaro bhavati iti bhāvaṃḥ | tatra vyavasthāmāha--keṣāmiti | tadubhayamityanuṣaṅgaḥ | ayamarthaḥ - keṣāṃcit vyaktānāṃ śabdānāṃ tadubhayaṃ vyaṅgyatvaṃ vyañjakatvaṃ ca, avyaktānāṃ tu dhvanireveti |
analyzed: vyaṅgya tvam vyañjaka tvam ca iti ubhayam svabhāvataḥ sva rūpeṇa iti arthaḥ śabdasya tādṛśa svabhāva tvāt na tatra pramāṇa antara apekṣā atha api yogi pratyakṣa gocaraḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ tatra vyavasthām āha keṣām iti tat ubhayam iti anuṣaṅgaḥ ayam arthaḥ keṣāṃcid vyaktānām śabdānām tat ubhayam vyaṅgya tvam vyañjaka tvam ca avyaktānām tu dhvaniḥ eva iti

original: kaustubhe'pi idaṃ bhāṣyādi itthameva vyākhyātam | tataśca bhāṣye, kārikāyā ca sphoyapadaṃ vyaṃgya ityarthakaṃ, sphuṭyata iti karmaṇi ghañantaṃ bāhulakāditi |
analyzed: kaustubhe api idam bhāṣya ādi ittham eva vyākhyātam tatas ca bhāṣye kārikāyā ca vyaṃgyaḥ iti arthakam sphuṭyate iti karmaṇi ghañ antam bāhulakāt iti

original: ayamatra niṣkarṣaḥ - idaṃ bhāṣyaṃ vṛttibhede vyaktibheda iti varṇānāṃ kāryatāvādinā codite varṇasya nityatvāt vṛttibhede'pi na bheda iti vyutpādanāya pravṛttaṃ, na tu vācakasya visakṣaṇasphoṭatvavyavasthāpanāyeti |
analyzed: ayam atra niṣkarṣaḥ idam bhāṣyam vṛtti bhede vyakti bhedaḥ iti varṇānām kārya tā vādinā codite varṇasya nitya tvāt vṛtti bhede api na bhedaḥ iti vyutpādanāya pravṛttam na tu vācakasya visakṣaṇa sphoṭa tva vyavasthāpanāya iti

original: `athavā ubhayataḥ sphoṭamātraṃ nirdiśyate raśruterlatirbhavati' iti `eoṅ' sūtrabhāṣyamapi varṇaiṃkadeśasya grahaṇāgrahaṇavicāre, agrahaṇapakṣe klṛptamityādau latvāsiddiśaṅkāṃ parihartuṃ pravṛttamiti na haryādyabhimatasphoṭasiddhyanukūlam |

original: tatra autpattikapadasya śabdābhivyaktikālika ityarthaḥ, bodhakatvaśaktiviśiṣṭaśabdasyaivābhivyaktiḥ, tataśca svābhāvika eva śabdārthayoḥ saṃbandha iti bhāṣyādibhāvaḥ evapameva manyante bahava ācāryāḥ saṃbandha iti bhāṣyarūḍhaḥ pakṣaḥ, bhāṣye'nukteḥ, `yenoccāritena arthasaṃpratyaya' iti bhāṣyeṇa cārthapratyāyakatvaṃ saṃbandha ityevāvagamāt |
analyzed: tatra autpattika padasya śabda abhivyakti kālikaḥ iti arthaḥ bodhaka tva śakti viśiṣṭa śabdasya eva abhivyaktiḥ tatas ca svābhāvikaḥ eva śabda arthayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti bhāṣya ādi bhāvaḥ manyante bahavaḥ ācāryāḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti bhāṣya rūḍhaḥ pakṣaḥ yena uccāritena artha saṃpratyayaḥ iti bhāṣyeṇa ca artha pratyāyaka tvam saṃbandhaḥ iti eva avagamāt
